name: article-body
purpose: The reading page of an article. A brand banner sits over a three-column grid: the share, community and copy-page rail on the left; the breadcrumb, headline, byline and prose down the middle at a reading measure; and the "On this page" outline on the right. Both rails stick under the header and fold away below `lg`, leaving the column alone. The section opens the page itself, so it carries its own `section-container` instead of sitting in the page column. The prose arrives as markdown: blank-line separated blocks render as `##` / `###` headings (each with an id slugged from its text, feeding the outline), `-` lists and paragraphs. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'article-body', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-container`, `section-module`, `frame-box`, `breadcrumb`, `hero-title`, `divider`, `doc-prose`, `tooltip`, `icon-button`, `split-button` and `doc-on-this-page`; copying to the clipboard is local behaviour.
useWhen: To open every blog post and every success story page.
avoidWhen: For a list of articles → use `article-index-blog`.
For a closing row of related articles → use `article-cards`.
related: doc-prose` — the reading-measure typography the body renders in.
doc-on-this-page` — the outline rail fed by the body's headings.
bestPractices: Write the body as plain blocks — headings, paragraphs and `-` lists separated by blank lines; inline markdown is rendered as text.

props.name: article
props.doc: The piece being read: its `title` (the page h1), `description`, `date`, `readTime` and canonical `href`.

props.name: trail
props.doc: The breadcrumb over the headline, each a `label` and an `href`, the last one marked `current`.

props.name: body
props.doc: The article as markdown; its `##` and `###` headings feed the outline.

props.name: banner
props.doc: URL of the image over the masthead; the banner frame is omitted when empty.

props.name: share
props.doc: Labels of the share group: its `title`, `copyLink`, `shareX` and `shareLinkedIn`; the group is omitted when absent.

props.name: community
props.doc: The community group: a `title` and `links`, each a `label`, an `href` and an `icon`; omitted when absent.

props.name: copyPage
props.doc: The copy-page split button: its `label` and a `menu` of entries, each a `value`, a `label` and an `icon`; omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default

<script setup>
  import ArticleBody from '@aziontech/webkit/article-body'
  import placeholderImage from '@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg'
</script>

<template>
  <ArticleBody
    eyebrow="Blog"
    :banner="placeholderImage"
    body="## Challenge

Magalu is the most innovative retail company in LATAM.

## Solution

Magalu counts on Azion’s platform to evolve its security posture.

## Results and Impact

Magalu simplified security operations by blocking millions of threats per year."
    :article="{
      title: 'Magalu Ensures High Availability at Scale with Azion',
      description:
        'Explore how Magalu enhances cybersecurity with Azion’s Firewall and WAF, improving threat intelligence and bot management in retail.',
      date: 'FEB 4, 2022',
      readTime: '5 min read',
      href: 'https://www.azion.com/en/success-case/magalu/'
    }"
    :trail="[
      { label: 'Success cases', href: '/success-cases' },
      { label: 'Retail', href: '/success-cases?industry=Retail' },
      { label: 'Magalu Ensures High Availability at Scale with Azion', current: true }
    ]"
    :share="{
      title: 'Share this article',
      copyLink: 'Copy link',
      shareX: 'Share on X',
      shareLinkedIn: 'Share on LinkedIn'
    }"
    :community="{
      title: 'Community',
      links: [
        {
          label: 'Join us on Discord',
          href: 'https://discord.com/invite/Yp9N7RMVZy',
          icon: 'pi pi-discord'
        },
        { label: 'Read our blog posts', href: '/blog', icon: 'pi pi-comment' },
        { label: 'Follow us on X', href: 'https://twitter.com/aziontech', icon: 'ai ai-x' }
      ]
    }"
    :copy-page="{
      label: 'Copy page',
      menu: [
        { value: 'link', label: 'Get page link', icon: 'pi pi-link' },
        { value: 'markdown', label: 'View page as markdown', icon: 'pi pi-eye' }
      ]
    }"
  />
</template>
